combined_static_contract_check.non_claim: Complete measured static contracts only. Raw mis-scoped ControllerSpec diagnostics remain in the graph report. Runtime payloads are not unknown artifact kinds and remain explicit unobserved protected-execution obligations. No independent model acceptance or launch authority.

limitations: Controller-produced RecipeInvocation bytes are absent from static source inputs; symbolic producer/emitter/strict-decoder contracts are counted, but actual runtime decode and output remain protected-execution obligations.
Unknown artifact binding kinds are retained as uncovered obligations; no kind is inferred from a digest or pathname.
Physical profile/NAR identity, protected execution, fixed-point equality, reproducibility, native signed-row acceptance, and release eligibility are not established by this static audit.
